verdict.rationale: Google Drive's API supports listing and downloading files (docs-10/26) and Google Docs can be exported to open formats, and community evidence confirms third-party tools like rclone can pull all content out of Drive and convert Google Docs to ODF (comm-5, comm-13). However, there is no first-party documentation in this pack of a native 'export everything' feature (e.g., Google Takeout) and no evidence of a one-click open-format bulk export within Drive itself. Missing for 10: first-party bulk-export/Takeout documentation, native open-format conversion guarantees, and independent verification that all data types (not just Docs) migrate cleanly.
